family.description: This domain, previously known as DUF8189, is found in the L-fucose-binding lectins PHL and PLLs(1-5) from various Photorhabdus species and their homologues. This domain forms a seven-bladed beta-propeller [[cite:PUB00100843],[cite:PUB00109482],[cite:PUB00161611]]. Each blade makes a W-motif composed of four antiparallel beta-strands (beta1-beta4) connected by beta-turns and loops. The C and N terminus are located on the same side of the torus and create a cap of the inner cavity of the torus. With exception of PLL3, which is a monomer, all other domains assemble into oligomeric structures, either homo-dimeric or homo-tetrameric, connected with an inter-subunit disulfide bridge [[cite:PUB00100843],[cite:PUB00109482],[cite:PUB00161611]]. Besides L-fucose or fucosylated saccharides, some of these domains bind to unusual O-methylated disaccharide 3,6-O-Me2-d-Glc-beta1-4(2,3-O-Me2)-l-Rha-alpha (MGMR) [[cite:PUB00161611]].
family.name: PLL-like beta propeller
